sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's energy transition hinges on the 2025 RUPTL revision, which will unlock capex for geothermal and solar-plus-storage, favoring local EPCs and IPPs with land permits.
US-listed solar equipment makers (ENPH, SEDG) benefit from IRA-driven demand and falling module costs, but their Indonesia relevance is limited to high-end commercial rooftops, not utility-scale.
Climate-tech capital is rotating toward small-cap disruptors (ARKO, KEEN) with niche battery or waste-to-energy IP, creating volatile but high-alpha windows for tactical traders.
sectors.ai: Indonesia's renewables lag persists despite global green-tech gains; ARKO's +9.62% signals speculative momentum on small-cap names, not fundamentals. Favor US-listed solar/utility plays (ENPH, SEDG, RUN) for near-term beta, but pivot to domestic policy-driven projects—geothermal and biomass—where IDX-listed issuers (373220, KEEN) offer asymmetric upside once regulatory clarity on feed-in tariffs emerges. Trim exposure to laggards like PCG; rotate into high-conviction names with confirmed offtake agreements.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG

Domestic staples face structural margin pressure from input cost inflation and weak purchasing power, favoring exporters and niche players with pricing power over mass-market names.
sectors.ai: Buy selective FMCG names with strong volume growth and margin expansion, as aggregate weakness masks robust single-stock momentum (BEEF, AGAR, TFCO). Favor exporters and raw-material beneficiaries over domestic staples; avoid laggards until IDX liquidity improves. Position for Q3 earnings beats in beef and agar-agar subsegments.
